column1: # Tier-2 checks for rules.md, read by the learning-loop plugin after Write/Edit operations.
# Advisory only: a report adds context and never blocks the write.
# PATH_GLOBS is a comma-separated list of shell patterns matched against repository-relative paths.
# REGEX is grep -E against lines added relative to HEAD. Special forms:
#   @new             Write created a file not tracked by git
#   @cross-module    added import of another module's internals; requires rulecheck.config
#   @file:<regex>    match the whole file instead of only added lines
# MESSAGE must not contain double quotes or backslashes because it is embedded in hook JSON.
